name: agent-authority
description: Open-source identity, authority contracts, delegation, policy enforcement, approvals, and audit primitives for AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:box && npm run build:cli && npm run build:enterprise
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/core-smoke.mjs && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/box-smoke.mjs && node tests/red-team.mjs && node tests/enterprise-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:enterprise: npm run build:core && npm run build:enterprise && node tests/enterprise-smoke.mjs
scripts.demo:score: npm run build:core && tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck examples/authority-score.ts --outDir .tmp-score && node .tmp-score/authority-score.js
